Description:
In the tumult of battle, you suffer grievous wounds, tumbling injured to the ground. Amidst the chaos, however, a beacon of hope catches your eye across the battlefield. Drawing nearer, you discern a figure brandishing a sacred symbol, poised to intervene in your plight. With a decisive strike, they confront your assailant and then approach, kneeling by your side. Yet disquieting feeling overtakes you - this Cleric's powers are not of the same god as yours. All gods demand something... what will this one demand of you for bringing you back on your feet?
Clerics are spellcasters deeply attuned to their religion, and while their magic source may be from a divine source, they nevertheless possess an understanding to wield magic, and more often than not, they have learned the secrets of their creed, and can put them to good use to attain their life's purpose.
A Cleric is a guide, a seeker of understandings. Clerics have the innate ability to heal and cause harm, and every Cleric has the option to embrace either side of the coin - war or peace, light or darkness, life or death. While they usually serve a greater god, no two Clerics are alike, and each has their own way of worship and path in life.

Spellcasting.Change: You can change your known Spells and Talents inbetween Adventures.
Spellcasting.Other: All Cleric-specific Abilities are considered Spells (unless stated otherwise).

Mana.Regain: You regain all Mana back inbetween Adventures.

Spellcasting.Recommended Abilities Description: They provide a good range of utility with Light, healing and supporting with Cure Wounds, Cure Affliction and Saving Throw, and some good damage with Dancing Weapon, Guiding Bolt (single-target) and Radiant Smite (area).

~Awe~.Effect:
Whenever you spend Mana, "cast Awe" on a Unit for each Mana spent.
Casting Awe deals 1d4 Divine Damage if it's an Enemy, or Heals if it's an Ally.
~Awe~.Notes: Ignores Cover. Some other Cleric spells will "cast Awe" for free.

~Blessing~.Effect:
Cast Awe on 2 Units and they become Blessed.
Blessed Allies have +1 to all non-Combat Rolls for the rest of the Adventure. Blessed Enemies become Slowed.

~Privilege~.Effect:
Heal a Player Character you can see for an amount equal to their Health Regen.
They do not Regen Health at the end of the Combat.
~Privilege~.Combo: They can Regen Health after Combat, but only for 50% of Health Regen.

~Mind's Thing~.Effect:
Deal 1d12 + ^Your Sense or Intelligence^ {Type} Damage to a Unit.
For the rest of the combat, whenever it would take {Type} Damage, it takes {Damage} more (stacks indefinitely).

~Click on the icon to selecte the preferred effect!~

~Solace Wave~.Effect:
Heal an ally (or yourself) for 1d8 Health.
If they have 50% or more Health before the heal, double the result!

~Elation~.Effect: Up to 2 Player Characters you can see gain Health Regen equal to your Intelligence.

<Weakness of the Soul>.Effect: Cast Awe on a Unit. It becomes Slowed and Blinded. Apply a ~Combo~.

~Warding Incense~.Effect:
Use when an ally would take Damage.
Roll 1d6 and subtract that much from the attack.
Then give them the rolled die as one Shielding and apply a ~Combo~ on them.

~Guidance~.Effect: When an ally makes a Check, it can use your modifiers (including being Skilled in that Skill) instead of its own.

~Saving Throw~.Effect:
Use when the Turn of an Enemy starts (or on your Turn).
Instantly pull another ally to your nearest empty space.
~Saving Throw~.Notes:
The ally goes flying.
You need line of sight to the targets. The allies fly to you ignoring obstacles and ground traps (goes around obstacles), unless the ally needs to swerve more than 2 meters in any direction.

~Mending~.Effect:
Touch a slightly broken piece of material that is still in one piece.
You can repair the Damage done to it.
Mending can repair a piece of Armor or Weapon for 1 Defense or Damage, but no more.
~Mending~.Notes: For example, repair a hole through a chain shirt or textile material, the crack in a piece of glass, etc.

~Compel~.Duration: Lasts until they can't see/hear you
~Compel~.Effect: Choose a Unit you can see. You have +1d2 to Charisma Rolls against it.
~Compel~.Notes: The target can't tell it was affected unless it knows about this type of magic.

~Herald of Radiance~.Effect:
Awe Damage and healing is 1d6 if you are at full Health.
You radiate light in a 3 meter radius.
~Herald of Radiance~.Notes: You can turn the light off at will.

~Herald of Twilight~.Effect:
Awe Damage and healing is 1d6 on targets at or below 50% Health.
You can see normally in the dark up to 5 meters away.

<Aspect>.Effect:
You take on a shadowy or illuminated appearance for the rest of the combat. Choose one:
{Diamond} Awe deals Scourge Damage. After you cast Awe, all your future Awe's deal +1 Damage. You can't heal (with anything).
{Diamond} After you heal someone, all your future heals heal for +1.

~Herald of the Moon~.Effect: If the Awe heals the target to Max Health, give them one Shielding that can block 1d4 Damage.

<Golden Shield>.Effect:
Use before a Unit you can see would take Damage (before the roll), or on your Turn.
It becomes surrounded in a divine golden shield.
This (or next) time it would take Damage, it is completely blocked.
If used on your Turn, apply a Combo.

~Guiding Bolt~.Effect:
A shining light bursts onto a Unit, dealing 2d8 + ^Sense^ Divine Damage to it.
The next time someone would cast a Spell that affects that Unit, the caster can reroll any of the spell's dice, at most one reroll for each die.
~Guiding Bolt~.Notes: This affects AoE effects and healing abilities too.

~Deafening Silence~.Effect: A Unit you can see takes 3d8 Psychic Damage and is Silenced.

~Reveling Rays~.Effect:
You shoot out 10 rays of light.
Roll 10d4 and assign them to Units within 10 meters as you with.
Each die heals on odd rolls (1 and 3) and deals Divine Damage on even rolls (2 and 4).

~Let There Be Light~.Effect: While standing in natural light (e.g. the sun), your Healing Awe has its ^Dice Upgraded^ to the next die type and you are immune to being Silenced.
~Let There Be Light~.Notes: {DiceUpgrade}. It is up to the Quest Master what is considered natural light.

<Let There Be Darkness>.Effect: While standing in environmental shadows, your damaging Awe has its ^Dice Upgraded^ to the next die type and your attacks ignore Cover.
<Let There Be Darkness>.Notes: {DiceUpgrade}. It is up to the Quest Master what is considered shadow.

~Assistance of Merit~.Effect: Whenever you use a Reaction, cast Awe or Single-Stun a Unit.

<Circle of Awe>.Effect:
Declare a 4x4 meter area. Cast Awe on all Units inside the area.
After casting Awe 3 times, reset the Cooldown of this Ability (except Awes from this Ability).

~Solace Tide~.Effect:
Heal an ally (or yourself) for ~1d10~ Health.
If they have 50% or more Health before the heal, double the result!

<Shadow Realm>.Effect:
A Unit within 6 meters becomes trapped in a Shadow Realm with you for 2 rounds (this and the next).
Your attacks cast Awe on it for free while inside the Shadow Realm.
<Shadow Realm>.Upgrade:
Neither of you can interact with the outside world, but can feintly see it.
Units on the outside can faintly see the two of you, as if you were ghosts.
<Shadow Realm>.Notes: The Shadow Realm is a copy of the normal world, but with no other units.

<Black Hole>.Effect:
Choose a point as the center of a Black Hole.
At the end of each Round, Slam* all Units within 6 meters of the Black Hole towards the center.
When one comes within 1 meter of the center, cast Awe on it and it becomes Slowed.
<Black Hole>.Upgrade: Only Units that meet in the center take Damage from the Slam. Each takes Damage equal to their own distance thrown (if they slam into eachother).
<Black Hole>.Notes: If Units are Slammed into other things, they take Damage as normal.

~Resurrection~.Effect:
Touch a dead Unit, whose body is still in decent condition (as approved by the QM).
The dead Unit comes back to life, conscious and without Exhaustion, with 1 Health.

~Water Walk~.Effect:
Up to 2 willing Units can walk on water as normally.
The effect ends if the Unit takes Damage.

~People's Awe~.Effect: Awe now hits all Units in a 2x2 area, but can't heal yourself and requires being in Worthy Combat.

<Maiming Dark>.Effect:
Triple-Stun a Unit and Single-Stunn another willing ally (not you). Then cast Awe on each.
These Units' Passive Abilities are disabled while affected.

<Healing Doubledown>.Effect: Until the end of your next turn, double all healing you and your party does.
<Healing Doubledown>.Notes: Doesn't stack with other healing multiplication effects.

<Inedianism>.Effect:
Whenever you cast a 0 Actions Class Ability or Talent, another ally gains 1 Mana.
Also, you don't need to eat or drink to live - you only need exposure to light.

Manual Extras: +1 in a Stat of choice (up to +5)
<Stat Bonus 5>.Effect: Gain +1 in a Stat of choice, up to +5.

<Mana Bonus>.Effect: Gain +1 Max Mana and +1 Known Ability.

<Edict of Awe Eternal>.Effect:
~Cast Awe twice. The dice results are increased by 50%.~
This deals 1d4 Divine Damage to enemies or heals allies for 1d4.
Passively, your Intelligence and Sense increase by 2 and you can effortlessly levitate up to 1 meter above the ground, water etc. and don't take fall Damage.

<Miracle>.Effect:
You pray with divine confidence and purpose, and, with the gods' will, you manifest your wish upon your mortal world.
Choose one of the following effects to manifest:
{Diamond} Manifest restoration: Choose a person you can touch to instantly and fully kill, resurrect or heal them, restore their body parts, injuries or handicaps, change their race, etc.
{Diamond} Manifest materialism: Create an object worth up to 5000 {Gold}Gold and make it appear out of thin air in a beacon of blinding light. Or choose an object or area worth that much and make it disappear; Units with their materialistic value worth a total of 5000 {Gold} or less also disappear.
{Diamond} Manifest fate: Determine or read the near future of one Unit.
{Diamond} Manifest mistake: Undo a recent past event that was not a Worthy Combat. You and your party remains in the present to witness the aftermath.
{Diamond} Manifest destruction: Deal 2d100 Scourge Damage spread (after rolling) as you like among Units within 10 meters.
{Diamond} Manifest development: Choose a Unit and increase up to 2 of their Stats by 1, or they permanently learn a new Basic Ability, etc.
{Diamond} Manifest creativity: Choose something else with a similar scope to do, if the gods will.
After casting Miracle, if the gods will, the Cooldown of Miracle may be reset if they deem the effect was not worthy enough.
<Miracle>.Notes: The gods' will is determined by the Quest Master. Talk to the QM about your possibilities.
